code_style: AI-code. AI-generated attributed Jpsi transition inputs.
physics_scope: Three exclusive Jpsi->P electromagnetic VP-current benchmarks. Bin-average empiricalpi0/eta and a conditional photon-matchedrho/omega/phi eta-prime family. Native unpolarized pole source and absolute pp production remain unvalidated. No universal all-meson or all-order completeness claim.
electromagnetic_mixing_note: Kernel epsilon is physical electromagnetic mixing. Source binding must apply the resolved hypercharge-to-EM conversion exactly once and BR(Aprime->mumu) exactly once. No such factors are present in TFF inputs.

parents.name: Jpsi
parents.polarization_note: Unpolarized native pp-production benchmark. The transverse e+e- collider parent spin state is not imported as a pp-production measurement.
parents.ownership_note: One direct Jpsi->P timelike electromagnetic current, inclusive of its virtual vector resonances. Natural Jpsi->PV followed by a separate V->P2 Aprime has an extra recoil and remains a different exclusive final state. Do not add an independent V->Aprime conversion source to this same current.

Not a precision pointwise current near narrow poles.

transition_form_factor.phase_envelope_note: Exact pointwise polygon-inequality range over all relative phases at central measured inputs. It is a conditional model range, not a confidence interval or a simultaneous mass-shape error. Central independent-phase average is an explicit unmeasured phase assumption.

parents.qualification_scope: Derived finite three-pole VP-current family with measured on-shell residues and measured continuum pole. Photon matching exact for every unknown phase; benchmark phase average and pointwise phase envelope are explicit. Only2me..2GeV is admitted, safely belowLambda minus its reported1GeV error. This is not a fitted coherent eta-prime amplitude or a global physical uncertainty bound.

absolute_dalitz_rate_check.note: Central-input current underpredicts the newer nonresonant measurement. Known pole phases cannot fix the deficit. The large older continuum-pole uncertainty partly covers it within the restricted domain, but its lower pole2.1GeV lies inside the complete physical endpoint2.13912GeV. No unrestricted zero-width extrapolation, rate rescaling or claimed absolute-rate qualification is made.
